finding: Original Civu readable moment contract includes a minimal Note.author with displayName and avatarUrl independently of profile_visibility. Birdtie private-profile-only author lookup is missing this retained public-content attribution, not evidence that the original name/avatar were never visible.
acl: Original list/detail enforce content deletion/moderation, audience and block/hide rules. Public listing further forces public audience. Attribution must remain subordinate to exact current readable-moment authority.
backupFields: users includes display_name/avatar_url/profile_visibility/status/version; notes includes author_id/visibility/moderation_status/deleted_at/created_at/version. Extraction and importer column allowlists retain them, but native importer writes user_profiles as private and does not import avatar bytes.
minimumAdaptation: Add provenance-bound original author attribution for preserved readable Civu public moments, using exact source author/moment mappings, source SHA/version, current blocks and withdrawal state. Keep native profile privacy unchanged. Import only verified avatar bytes into controlled bounded derivative reads; never return arbitrary old URLs.
excludedReuse: Civu handleFromEmail derives a handle from an email address; do not carry this fallback into new attribution.
notClaimed: Old author attribution now fully restored
